records.name: Gathering Basket
records.description: For gently collecting light, renewable materials: seeds, berries, flowers, fiber, shells.

tiers.name: Gathering Basket
tiers.effect: Carry up to 200 materials and gather 1 at a time.

tiers.name: Reinforced Gathering Basket
tiers.effect: Carry up to 350 materials and gather 2 light materials at a time.

tiers.name: Woven Carryall
tiers.effect: Carry up to 550 materials and gather 3 at a time.

tiers.name: Naturalist's Pack
tiers.effect: Carry up to 800 materials and gather 4 at a time.

tiers.name: Relay Pack
tiers.effect: Carry up to 1,100 materials and gather 5 at a time. A full basket sends the overflow to your nearest chest instead of turning you away.

tiers.name: Frame Pack
tiers.effect: Carry up to 1,500 materials and gather 6 at a time. A stiff frame takes the weight out of stone, clay and sand.

tiers.name: Harvest Pack
tiers.effect: Carry up to 2,000 materials and gather 7 at a time. One pass clears a whole patch of whatever you are gathering.

records.name: Basic Shovel
records.description: For carefully digging stones, clay, and sand, and preparing restoration ground.

tiers.name: Basic Shovel
tiers.effect: Dig stones, clay, and sand; gather 1 at a time.

tiers.name: Restoration Shovel
tiers.effect: Shape wetland mud banks and burrow mounds; gather 2 dug materials.

tiers.name: Tempered Spade
tiers.effect: Dig faster and gather 3 dug materials at a time.

tiers.name: Earthshaper's Spade
tiers.effect: Shape the toughest ground and gather 4 dug materials at a time.

tiers.name: Broad Spade
tiers.effect: Dig 5 at a time. Adds a 3×3 brush to your shovel — pick it when you want it; it stays on one square until you do.

tiers.name: Survey Spade
tiers.effect: Dig 6 at a time. You can read the ground now — buried material shows where it lies, and digging it up is certain.

tiers.name: Salvage Spade
tiers.effect: Dig 7 at a time. Adds a 9×9 brush, and clearing ground gives back the water and material it soaked up.

records.name: Tin Watering Can
records.description: For carrying water to thirsty ground and new plantings.

tiers.name: Tin Watering Can
tiers.effect: Collect 1 water from springs and streams.

tiers.name: Rainwater Canteen
tiers.effect: Collect 2 water at a time — restore dry ground more efficiently.

tiers.name: Spring-fed Ewer
tiers.effect: Collect 3 water at a time for rivers, lakes, and lush beds.

tiers.name: Cloudcatcher Urn
tiers.effect: Collect 4 water at a time — flood whole channels in a few trips.

tiers.name: Long-spout Can
tiers.effect: Collect 5 water at a time. Adds a 3×3 brush, so you can water a bed or a whole patch — your choice, one square by default.

tiers.name: Dipping Pail
tiers.effect: Collect 6 water at a time, and fill straight from any open water you have shaped.

tiers.name: Channel Urn
tiers.effect: Collect 7 water at a time. Adds a 9×9 brush for filling a channel in one pass, as far as your water goes.

records.name: Willow Meadow Field Guide
records.description: Your notes on Willow Meadow, bound up as you fill them in. The field guide opens each returned neighbour’s full page; the expanded edition spells out exactly what everyone still missing is waiting for.

tiers.name: Willow Meadow Pocket Notes
tiers.effect: Names, sketches and a caretaker’s hint for every neighbour of this place.

tiers.name: Willow Meadow Field Guide
tiers.effect: Opens the full page for every animal here: role, food web, when to spot them, and the habitat they keep.

tiers.name: Willow Meadow Expanded Guide
tiers.effect: Spells out exactly what every animal here is waiting for — habitat, health, water, and weather — in the journal and on your goals.
